reason: Both identify the identical root cause: the code checks a Flow object reference for null (which is always non-null) instead of awaiting/collecting its first emitted value via .first(). Both trace this to the same runtime consequence — startDestination always resolves to the main app, so new users never see onboarding. The reviewer's phrasing ('observe() always returns a non-null Flow') is a paraphrase of the ground truth's 'the object reference is never null' — same mechanism, same location, same misbehavior.
